title: Langrisser IV
overview:
Ancient times, people had battle in order to survive. Their battle for an affluent Kingdom became a legend. The legend is known as...

Langrisser IV is a strategy RPG set on the Yeless Continent two centuries after the events of Langrisser II, when the legend of the holy sword has faded and the kingdoms are at odds once again. The aging wizard Gizlof, hungry for eternal life and conquest, raids Gotahl Village to seize the Sage's Crystal and carries off Randius' sister Rachel. Randius escapes and sets out to rescue her and stop Gizlof.

Lead your commanders and the mercenary troops under their command across overhead battle maps, then watch the clashes play out in combat scenes. A new turn system decides when each unit gets to act. Your answers to a questionnaire at the start shape how Randius grows, and the choices you make along the way lead the story down the Light, Chaos or Independence path, each with its own allies, enemies and ending.

- Story told across numbered scenarios
- Commanders lead hired mercenary units
- Class growth with hidden classes
- Three story paths
- Special Package edition
